title: The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild
titleEn: The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild
description: The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild reimagines the Zelda formula as a vast open-air adventure. After awakening from a 100-year slumber, Link must recover his memories, survive the harsh wilderness, and challenge Calamity Ganon. The journey blends shrine puzzles, physics-driven experimentation, open exploration, cooking, weapon durability, and one of Nintendo's most acclaimed adventure worlds.

gameplayPillars.title: Open-air exploration
gameplayPillars.description: Climb, glide, ride, and experiment across a huge version of Hyrule where the world rarely forces a fixed order.

gameplayPillars.title: Physics-driven problem solving
gameplayPillars.description: Fire, metal, wind, explosives, and environmental interactions create emergent solutions in both puzzles and combat.

gameplayPillars.title: Shrines and Divine Beasts
gameplayPillars.description: More than one hundred shrines and four Divine Beasts provide puzzle-driven progression and memorable dungeon-style goals.

gameplayPillars.title: Survival systems and cooking
gameplayPillars.description: Weather, stamina, food, elixirs, and gear preparation matter constantly, especially in tougher climates and battles.

gameplayPillars.title: Weapon variety and improvisation
gameplayPillars.description: Weapons break over time, encouraging experimentation with swords, spears, bows, shields, runes, and environmental tricks.

worldSummary: Hyrule is presented as a giant interconnected wilderness full of towers, shrines, villages, stables, enemy camps, and hidden landmarks that reward curiosity from the first hour to the final battle.

storyChapters.title: Awaken on the Great Plateau
storyChapters.body: Link wakes after a century of sleep and begins learning the basics of survival and exploration while the mysterious voice of Zelda guides him.

storyChapters.title: Recover memories across Hyrule
storyChapters.body: As Link explores, he uncovers the past through recovered memories and learns what happened before Calamity Ganon consumed Hyrule.

storyChapters.title: Free the Divine Beasts
storyChapters.body: Link can aid the peoples of Hyrule and liberate the Divine Beasts from Ganon's control, weakening the final threat.

storyChapters.title: Prepare through shrines, gear, and allies
storyChapters.body: The adventure supports many play styles: players can hunt for stronger gear, solve shrines, cook buffs, tame horses, and master combat systems.

storyChapters.title: Face Calamity Ganon
storyChapters.body: Once ready, Link can storm Hyrule Castle and confront the source of the calamity in an ending shaped by the journey taken.

features: Massive freedom in exploration and progression order
Shrine puzzle content and physics-based experimentation
Expansion Pass adds new story and challenge content
One of Nintendo's most acclaimed single-player adventures

faq.q: Does Breath of the Wild support Nintendo Switch 2?
faq.a: Yes. Nintendo lists the original Nintendo Switch version as supported on Nintendo Switch 2, with behavior consistent with Nintendo Switch.

faq.q: What is included in the Expansion Pass?
faq.a: The Expansion Pass includes the Master Trials content and The Champion's Ballad story content, plus some bonus in-game treasure chests.
No. Breath of the Wild is a single-player adventure with no competitive or cooperative gameplay modes.
Very open. After the opening area, players can choose where to explore, which shrines to tackle, and when to approach the main objective.

faq.q: Why is this game so highly regarded?
faq.a: Its sense of discovery, systemic design, environmental freedom, and cohesive open-world structure made it one of the most celebrated action-adventure games of its generation.

verdictPros: Systems-based exploration and combat feel fresh
Shrines and environmental puzzles are highly memorable
Expansion Pass meaningfully extends the adventure
Hyrule rewards curiosity at every scale
verdictCons: Traditional Zelda dungeons are lighter than in some older entries
Performance is a 30 fps experience on the original Switch
Story is more environmental than cinematic
Inventory management can feel busy early on
